mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE > 5.5% condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate remains below 0.5%, the real interest rate is negative, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation fears and delayed monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% and year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to heightened recession risk and profit margin compression, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the late-cycle expansion regime condition.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 105.5 indicates robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in strong economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO > 105.5.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a slack labor market that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure exceeding 1020.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite HOUST > 1020.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1020.0 thousand units and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 450,000 million dollars, the economy is in a strong consumption-driven expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the joint condition of HOUST > 1020.0 and RSAFS > 450000.0.
